generation.retention: at most eight currently living offspring per selected lineage, one proof per lineage; no unlimited individual histories

R3.rule: 51 committed turns with main present, actual production/acquisition and birth or basal regrowth are necessary; global totals alone do not certify a particular continuing food web path
